from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's filing for the relevant quarter."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    consolidated_net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income amount; negative if loss")
    net_cash_from_operating_activities: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities; negative if used")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    quote_net_income: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the net income figure")
    quote_operating_cash_flow: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the operating cash flow figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
